concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-salesforce-order-management-system-set-up-oobo]] — 2024-modified, 2026-09-15-captured OOBO card/Pay by Link setup guide for Salesforce OMS, with v3.2.0+ link gate, SFCC/OMS roles and connections, order/link creation, webhook migration and link-expiry controls; link generation is not payment or capture proof.
warnings: The existing OMS concept is present but lacks a visible provider-index link; coordinator should add the canonical concept route.
OOBO Pay by Link order and link generation do not establish shopper payment, authorization, capture or settlement; this page gives no capture policy.
Link Expire and Regenerate actions invalidate all previously associated links for the order.
